text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A lone wolf. While Narita Brian runs all on her own,
No Reason challenges her, watching for any opening.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Oraaaah!
Daaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: First thing in the morning, even someone like Sir Brian's body can't possibly be fully awake yet!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Though it is not the dead of night when even trees and grass sleep...
if it is the exhausted late hours, then surely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dawn raids, night assaults, bring on anything. But...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Oraaaah!
Nnnnghh?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* In the end, not a single win, huh.
You are quite something yourself, you know...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a Triple Crown Umamusume.
I'm simply no match for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Considering who the opponent is...
It's understandable you couldn't win, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Completely unrefined. Her body is fragile, too.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Why does this stir my instincts so much?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Zoryaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"The 'fleeting moment of ferocity' shown when striking down an opponent
—has been sharpened even further."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even against a superior opponent,
she has "something" that makes you think, "Could she actually win...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: With these legs, perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she didn't say much, Narita Brian seemed to acknowledge
No Reason's talent and growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I received Master's seal of approval—
on a certain winter day.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha!
How refined of you, Lord Brian.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Just the two of us... gazing upon a snowy landscape like this is quite nice indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason and Narita Brian
stood side by side, gazing at the snow-covered garden.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Sir Brian.
Looking at the snow...
It makes me think of something.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —A certain something?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Snow vanishes completely without a trace once spring arrives.
However...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Do you not think to yourself,
'I will not vanish like snow.
I will surely leave my hoofprints behind'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian says nothing,
only watching the snow in silence.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: For the time being, our rough style of running can hardly be called mainstream in this era. However...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If we overthrow the top and overturn the world...
our running will surely be passed down
for generations to come.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Well now, do you not think this is the true ambition of a warrior?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "Who cares about the future? As long as I can spend my own time living lawlessly, that's enough."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even if only a wasteland remains after the snow thaws,
I wouldn't care in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Good grief, thou art quite cold, aren't thee?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet that is precisely what makes her great! It is because she throws all caution to the wind
that she can run with such magnificent fury.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, save the flattery.
I have only one thing to say to you—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming Satsuki Sho.
—Blow them all away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Meaning or purpose doesn't matter.
Just win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Right now, no one has noticed your blade yet.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mm. After all, everyone's attention is focused on that eccentric Gimlet-dono.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You won't realize my true caliber until after
you've been struck down from behind! Nya-hahaha!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we celebrate in advance,
Brian-dono, and Trainer?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Our spring is right around the corner!
Come now~ drink it down in one gulp, bottoms up♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We quietly clinked our cups together. With the Satsuki Sho
in mind, our snowy rally was conducted in serene silence.
